title: JDE Replica - Finance Activity Review
summary: Pre-cutover read-only finance activity review against the GoldenGate JDEDEMO replica.

platform.product: Oracle AI Database Private Agent Factory

memory.description: Fresh evidence on every run; disable memory and cross-thread sharing after import.

capabilities: Oracle PL/SQL executor with an explicit one-routine allowlist
Bounded read-only evidence with explicit grain, dates and interpretation limits.
prerequisites: PAF 26.7-compatible visual Agent Builder and an available model.
JDE Replica Finance Read Only with the documented views or read-only routine.

tools.name: GET_GL_ACTIVITY
tools.purpose: Pre-cutover read-only finance activity review against the GoldenGate JDEDEMO replica.

safetyControls: Read-only application access; no posting, approvals, payments, enrollment, messages, job restart or cancellation.
Historical dates, organization, currency, units and row grain stay visible; empty and failed queries must be disclosed.
The shared integration reader does not reproduce per-person application authorization.
setup: Import the generated .paf with the repository passphrase; keep it unpublished while reviewing.
Rebind each database node to JDE Replica Finance Read Only. Bind to the GoldenGate target JDEDEMO PDB, not the original JDEORCL source. Keep the source connections and published flows separate.
Select the model on every Agent node; model connections are excluded from the archive.
Disable Agent Memory and sharing between chat threads for this flow; those switches are not bundled in the official export.
Run the primary prompt, inspect the actual evidence, and use the limitations follow-up.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: Review the five most recent GL activity rows available in the replica. Show their actual dates, company, currency and ledger context, then suggest a finance review step. Treat this as a bounded sample, not a ledger balance.

steps.speaker: User
steps.text: Explain what this bounded replica evidence cannot prove and what a human owner should verify before acting.

expectedOutcomes: A bounded evidence-backed explanation and a concrete next step for a human owner.
A clear distinction between the observed sample and claims it cannot establish.

validation.environment: build.oracleagentfactory.com; existing read-only demo application sources
validation.status: Passed live demo run; unpublished draft
notes: The exact exported visual graph completed its primary business prompt on build.oracleagentfactory.com with memory disabled.
Database rows, model responses, credentials, access tokens and private audit files are not included in this public sample.
This is a working demo path, not a comprehensive business accuracy, regression, load or authorization certification. Inspect evidence when presenting.
The primary prompt was rerun in a fresh conversation with memory explicitly disabled. The suggested limitations follow-up is illustrative and was not rerun for this sample.
PAF SQL identity checks confirmed the target PDB is JDEDEMO under the matching demo account. Application cutover was not performed.

catalog.question: What do the latest stored GL entries show by company, currency and ledger?
